forum.title: X-CUBE-FREERTOS 1.6.0 on STM32H7
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello ​@nico23

Unfortunately, for the moment there is no plan to upgrade the FreeRTOS version in STM32CubeH7.
forum.content_text:
I’m seeing that the X-CUBE-FREERTOS packege is being updated to 1.6.0 to support FreeRTOS 11.2

From the changelog it says that it’s restricted to

- Restricted to processor vendor: STMicroelectronics:13

- Restricted to processor name matching: STM32H5\*|STM32U5\*|STM32C0\*|STM32WBA\*|STM32U0\*|STM32N6\*|STM32U3\*

Are there any plans to bring to STM32H7\* as well?
forum.author: nico23

scraped_replies.html:
Hello ​@nico23 

At this time, there are no plans to add STM32H7 support to X-CUBE-FREERTOS.
The STM32CubeH7 package already includes FreeRTOS support.
scraped_replies.author: Saket_Om

scraped_replies.html: Thanks for the replay. Is there any plan to update the STM32CubeH7 package to FreeRTOS 11.2?
scraped_replies.author: nico23

scraped_replies.html:
Hello ​@nico23 

Unfortunately, for the moment there is no plan to upgrade the FreeRTOS version in STM32CubeH7.
